title: Delivery & Pickup Services Tariff Footnote: High-Value Express Order Supplement
content:
A Delivery & Pickup Services express order carries a high-value supplement in its express fee, on top of the express speed charge, that depends on the express order's value as its order record shows it (the patient pay of its prescriptions plus any store items).

| Express order's value | High-value supplement |
|---|---|
| $250.00 or more | $2.00 |
| at least $100.00 but below $250.00 | $1.00 |
| below $100.00 | none |

## Edges (hypothetical order values)

| Order value | Supplement |
|---|---|
| $99.99 | none |
| $100.00 | $1.00 |
| $249.99 | $1.00 |
| $250.00 | $2.00 |
| $412.60 | $2.00 |

The value read is that of the express order whose fee is being booked, the most recently placed express order on the plan.
